messages:
maya: Customer ACME (pilot) asked for per-tenant SLA tiers + clear cost caps. Problem statement: they need predictable latency and budget control for embedded search use. Sales timeline: Q2. Need PRD intake: goals/non-goals/acceptance criteria/metrics. Can product + eng help scope?

ryan: quick q — do they expect hardware isolation or logical QoS? Sales says logical first. No dedicated GPUs in Q2. Can we commit to p95 targets per-tier?

sasha: edgecases to call out: cold starts, large-batch imports, traffic spikes when tenant runs evals, model fallback quality drop. Non-goal: per-tenant model fine-tuning in Q2.

eli: propose success metrics:
- SLA hit rate per tenant (p95 <= X ms, target >= 99%)
- # of automatic fallbacks per week (should be < 1 per tenant)
- Cost variance vs baseline (delta <= 10%)
Rollout: canary with 5 low-risk tenants -> expand.

maya: Draft acceptance criteria:
```
- Implement per-tenant QoS profiles with configurable p95 latency and cost cap.
- Expose API and Console UI to set tier (bronze/silver/gold) and overrides.
- System enforces cost cap via token throttling + graceful 429 with structured reason payload.
- Fallback policy: automatic downgrade to cheaper model when latency SLO breached, with quality regression monitor and audit log.
- Dashboard shows SLA hit rate, fallback events, and cost burn per tenant.
- Documentation + runbook for SRE and customer success.
```

ryan: couple of follow-ups: what's the tolerance for transient breaches? We need an SLO window (5-minute rolling) and a grace threshold. Also need default tiers values. Propose gold p95=250ms, silver p95=500ms, bronze p95=1s.

sasha: Edge cases: tenant bursts that exceed capacity -> should we queue or drop? I vote for short queue + user-visible ETA. Also consider billing when we throttle.

maya: Non-goals (to be explicit): per-tenant hardware, per-tenant model training, custom quantization profiles per tenant in Q2.

ops-bot: SRE note: we'll need metrics on KV cache hit rate and cold-start percent. Add alert: >3 fallback events per hour across tenants -> page oncall.

eli: Next steps:
- Product to finalize acceptance criteria + default tier values (maya)
- Eng to estimate + list major risks (ryan + sasha)
- CS to identify 5 pilot tenants and success criteria (liaison)
Target: have PRD draft by EOD next Wednesday :calendar:

maya: thanks all — adding to PRD tracker. @ryan @sasha please post rough estimate in thread when you have it. :thumbsup:
